info.description: Every /api/v1 route: sign-in and accounts, people and invites, backups, the Library (movies, Versions, Library folders, Never-add, Release gate, Outside lists), the Requests (movies, shows and music) and Alerts (Discord, email, webhook), Sources, search, Downloaders and Downloads, music (artists, albums, Pressings and tracks from MusicBrainz), Organise for movies and shows (naming, rename, delete a title, a season or episodes, adopting a movie or show library, where files go), History (by title or episode), health checks, media servers, parts and the owner and admin controls (part switches, stages, linked apps, whole-app restart and shut down), and the calendar of movie dates and episodes with its iCal feed. Every route needs a signed-in session (cookie plus the X-CSRF-Token header for changes) or an API key in X-Api-Key, unless its security is empty; x-holyarrs-permission names what the route needs (self, signed_in, users and owner are roles; public needs no sign-in because the route checks a key of its own, as the iCal feed does; the rest are permissions). Secrets are never answered: they come back masked. This file is generated from the code: the operations are the registered routes, and x-holyarrs-permission, x-holyarrs-scope and x-holyarrs-part come from the route table. An API key holds one or more scopes (x-holyarrs-scopes lists them) and reaches only the routes whose x-holyarrs-scope it holds; a key cannot make a key with a scope it does not hold, and a key's scopes never change after it is made. How long a route stays after it is marked deprecated is written in design/system/api-promise.md (at least 12 months for routes outside apps use).

post.description: Answers the invite link once; it ends after its days (1 to 30). max_rating is a Kid's age-rating limit: one value from G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17 or TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-G, TV-PG, TV-14, TV-MA, or empty for no limit. rating_country is US (only US ratings are known for now). The person who joins gets the invite's limit. Only member invites can carry a limit; an unknown rating, a country other than US, or a limit on an admin invite answers 400. A person with a limit may hold only the ask and auto_approve permissions; any other permission with a limit answers 400 "A Kid account can only ask for titles."

delete.description: The link stops working.

put.description: Role, permissions, state and age-rating limit; the owner cannot be changed here. max_rating is a Kid's age-rating limit: one value from G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17 or TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-G, TV-PG, TV-14, TV-MA, or empty for no limit. rating_country is US (only US ratings are known for now). An empty max_rating clears the limit and a left-out one keeps it. Only members can have a limit; making someone an admin clears it. An unknown rating, a country other than US, or a limit on an admin answers 400. A person with a limit may hold only the ask and auto_approve permissions; any other permission with a limit answers 400 "A Kid account can only ask for titles."

get.description: The 256 by 256 JPEG of an active person, with an ETag; a matching If-None-Match answers 304.

post.description: Give someone below you a new password when they forgot it. They are signed out everywhere and their API keys stop.

400.description: The password is too short or the body is wrong.

get.description: Every live session of one person. The owner sees everyone's; an admin sees members' and their own.

403.description: Only the owner sees the owner's and admins' sessions.

post.description: Ends every session of one person (the caller's own session stays when the person is the caller). Same reach as the list.

403.description: Only the owner may end the owner's and admins' sessions.

delete.description: Ends one session of one person by its public id. Same reach as the list.

403.description: Only the owner may end the owner's and admins' sessions.

delete.summary: End one of a person's sessions

post.description: The owner removes one of a person's linked identities and ends the sessions it made. When it is their only way in, send confirm_no_way_in.

409.description: Conflict.

post.description: Reset a person's two-factor sign-in.

get.description: Lists the streaming services TMDB knows in one region (region=two-letter country code), for movies and shows together: id, name, logo and priority (TMDB's order for that region, lowest first). Cached a day. Counts against the Explore minute limit when not cached.

429.description: Too many Explore requests this minute.

200.description: Badges, awards, life facts and the Wikipedia bio; empty when unknown

get.summary: Awards (Wikidata) and the Wikipedia bio for a movie, show or person

x-holyarrs-scopes.admin: People, invites, ask limits, API keys, password and two-factor sign-in, sign-in settings, backups (list, download, restore) and the outside-service key settings: every route only the owner or an admin may use, the key and sign-in routes of My account, and every GET route not marked read. Making or promoting an admin also needs the control scope.
x-holyarrs-scopes.all: Read, write and admin together (every route but the controls). Every key made before scopes existed holds this one.
x-holyarrs-scopes.compat: The arr API only (/sonarr/ and /radarr/, for Seerr and Overseerr). Only the keys made for it (POST /api/v1/settings/old-app-api/keys/{side}) hold this scope; an API key cannot be made with it.
x-holyarrs-scopes.control: The controls: part switches, stage pause, resume and restart, reconnecting one linked app, whole-app restart, restart in safe mode and shut down.
x-holyarrs-scopes.health_read: Health states only, for monitoring companions.
x-holyarrs-scopes.mcp: An AI connection only: the AI tools route and nothing else. The tools act as the key's person, within their permissions.
x-holyarrs-scopes.read: Look: the GET routes that hand out no secrets (backups, keys, tokens, sign-in settings and the people list need admin).
x-holyarrs-scopes.write: Change: every route that is not a GET, except the admin ones and the controls.
